name: Christmas Snowflakes
author: Amit Dholiya

sections.description:
Christmas Snowflakes adds a festive animated snowfall effect to your WordPress website using optimized SVG snowflakes.
Features include per-page shortcode control, global options, December-only mode, adjustable speed, color, and flake count, plus mobile and desktop SVG sets.

Features

  • Lightweight SVG snowflake animation
  • Adjust flakes per second, min/max speed, and color
  • Desktop and mobile SVG flake sets
  • Shortcode override support
  • Homepage-only and December-only display options
  • Shortcode-only mode (no global snow)

Shortcode

Basic:
[christmas_snow]

Override example:
[christmas_snow flakes=”20″ color=”#00aaff” speed_min=”2″ speed_max=”8″ svg_set=”mobile”]
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload ZIP via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate plugin via Plugins.
  3. Configure settings under Settings → Christmas Snowflakes.
sections.faq:
Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin loads only when needed and uses lightweight SVG animations.

Can I enable snow only in December?

Yes — enable “December Only” mode in settings.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — it uses a lighter mobile SVG set automatically.
